evidence: Homepage lists 8 ICH items ("共 8 个非遗项目"), each with image, title, English subtitle, category badge, region, and short description.
Clicking "了解详情" on list items and on panorama hotspot overlays navigates to dedicated routes, e.g. /heritage/spring-festival, /heritage/paper-cutting, /heritage/suzhou-embroidery.
Detail page for 剪纸 shows title, English name, category, region (陕西 · 黄土高原), inscription year (2009年入选), full description paragraph, and 3 browsable images.
Category combobox lists 传统工艺/传统表演/民俗活动/传统美术; selecting 传统工艺 filtered list to 2 items (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂). Search box "京剧" correctly filtered to 1 matching item. Sort combobox offers 按名称/按年份/按地区.

List filter(传统工艺)+sort(按地区) preserved after visiting a detail page and navigating back. Panorama drag-rotate (transform translateX 0→90px) and wheel-zoom (scale 1→1.1) both function; after opening a hotspot overlay, navigating to its detail page and back, the exact rotation/zoom transform and the open hotspot overlay were both restored. Hotspot anchor % positions continue to update after zoom (real-time recalculation, not paused).
Panorama view showed "正在加载热点... (2/8)" hotspot-loading progress prompt. Detail page for 春节 showed "图片加载失败" fallback message with icon when the main image failed to load.
All 8 items display exactly one of the 4 valid categories (传统美术, 传统工艺, 传统表演, 民俗活动) as a badge on both the list card and panorama hotspot.

Valid item links/hotspots navigate to correct detail pages. Navigating to an invalid slug /heritage/nonexistent-item-xyz shows "未找到该非遗项目" not-found message with a "返回首页" link instead of rendering a fake/broken detail page.
Every list card and detail page shows title, description text, and region (e.g. "北京 · 华夏大地", "陕西 · 黄土高原") for all 8 items checked.

List view shows a hero banner, stat counters, filter toolbar and card grid; Detail view instead shows a breadcrumb trail, large image gallery with thumbnails, single-column info panel and "返回全景探索/浏览更多项目" actions — structurally and visually distinct layouts.

All 8 displayed items (春节 Spring Festival, 端午龙舟 Dragon Boat Racing, 剪纸 Paper Cutting, 京剧 Peking Opera, 昆曲 Kunqu Opera, 书法 Chinese Calligraphy, 苏绣 Suzhou Embroidery, 宜兴紫砂 Yixing Purple Clay) are genuine, well-documented Chinese ICH items; descriptions match publicly known facts (e.g. 剪纸 UNESCO inscription in 2009, 昆曲 as "百戏之祖", 京剧 as "国粹").
